messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Ryan Peek's presentation on using xts and ggplot for time-series data
parts:
Hi all,

Ryan gave a great presentation today on using the xts and ggplot packages to process and plot time-series data collected from data loggers.  His code and notes are posted here: http://goo.gl/kcRXu

Next week Mason Earles will talk about how he uses R to interface with models written in other programming languages.

Noam
